notes.title: Invasion has Begun
notes.content:
[b][h1]MAJOR CHANGES[/h1][/b]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
- New Faction: Machines of Invasion are being beamed in from space and are here to take over the planet. This faction has higher priced per unit but each unit is stronger than other faction counterparts. They also bring rechargeable shields to the battlefield.

- Fair map generation option: Added an option on the match start screen that allows you to set the map to generate fairly. This will generate one side of the map and copy and mirror that to the other side so both players will have the same buildings in the same position as the other.


[b][h1]MINOR CHANGES[/h1][/b]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
- 8 New Achievements: All centered around the new faction

[h2]REWORK[/h2]
- Changes to both unit AI and the AI player: Units are a bit better at navigating and not getting stuck in weird spots. The ai player is a bit quicker at the start of the match so now it won't get outpaced as easily

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

- Captains are no longer immune to fire
- Changes to text on the keybindings screen on the main menu
- Fixed new achievements being unobtainable

notes.title: A New Faction Appears To Light The World Ablaze
notes.content:
[h1]MAJOR CHANGES[/h1]

[b]NEW[/b]

- Added a new faction to the came called The Unending Blaze Cult.
This faction is centered around lighting eveything on fire, including themselves. They take reduced damage from being on fire and most of them gain buffs when they are on fire. Their units are also a bit cheaper than then current faction in the game.

[h1]MINOR CHANGES[/h1]

[b]NEW[/b]

- Added 8 new achievements to go for
- Added a bar underneath the money UI to show how full your bank is

[b]REWORK[/b]

- Juggernaut now has less recovery after losing it's target
- Changes to the start match screen to support more than 1 faction

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

- Added invisible walls on the edges of maps so you can't fall into the void
- Captains buff wasn't working on some FDF units
- Minor bug fixes
